parole.significato: bag, pack (fabric, leather, etc. object with straps or handles, used for carrying small objects, groceries, etc.)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Old East Slavic сума (suma) (compare Russian сума́ (sumá)), itself borrowed (via Polish) from Old High German soum (“burden”) (compare German Saum), from Ancient Greek σάγμα (ságma) (whence also Latin sagma, sauma (“burden saddle, burden”)). The borrowing happened in the 13th century,
